verdict.rationale: Slate is itself a terminal coding agent, so it plays the MCP client role. Serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. Nothing in the evidence shows Slate running as an MCP server, such as an 'mcp serve' subcommand or a hosted MCP endpoint, so this axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
